subject: Orbital Inc - production latency & errors: commercial remedy worksheet
messages:
From: Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@orbitalinc.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@orbitalinc.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact - sustained latency and 5xx spike (need credits)

Hi Kimberly —

We hit a sustained regression in response latency and a spike in 5xxs during our peak window this morning (08:30–09:10 PT). Our monitoring shows median latency rising from ~160ms to ~1.4s and error rates up to 6% for the affected routes. This impacted several customer flows.

Can you confirm:
- What caused the regression (root cause update)?
- Whether Redwood will consider a commercial remedy (credits) for the customer impact; Orbital’s finance/legal teams are asking for an estimate to start internal approvals.

I attached the service logs and a short sample timeline. We need an initial answer by EOD PT today if possible so we can brief our Execs.

—Aaron
Principal SRE, Orbital Inc
[Attachment: orbital_error_log_20261015.txt]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@orbitalinc.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - sustained latency and 5xx spike (need credits)

Aaron — thanks for the heads-up and for the logs. I'm really sorry Orbital hit this during peak.

Quick status: Rishi and Marcus are investigating now. Initial signal shows a degradation in one of the GPU host pools serving your region that caused request queueing and intermittent resource exhaustion. We’ve routed traffic to a healthy pool and applied an emergency autoscale policy for your deployment.

For credits: we track impact windows and calculate remedies per the SLA. Marcus will send a preliminary credit worksheet for your review; Laura (Legal) and I will follow up on the contract remediation path.

Can you confirm which billing month this impact falls in for your records (Oct billing cutoffs vary)? I’ll get an estimate to you before EOD PT.

Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@orbitalinc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - sustained latency and 5xx spike (need credits)

Hi all —

Attached preliminary credit_calc_v1.xlsx. I used the SLA agreed terms (99.9% availability per route) and the window Aaron sent. Two scenarios included:
- A: conservative credit (applies to Oct invoice): credits equal to 10% of Oct usage for the impacted routes during the measured degradation window.
- B: make-whole offer tied to a short-term service credit + free Dedicated capacity trial for 30 days (to regain confidence).

Numbers: Scenario A -> $18,240 credit; Scenario B -> $12,000 credit + 30-day trial (no charge). These are preliminary and require Legal signoff for the amendment.

Notes: I flagged a manual measurement discrepancy where prefix caching may have masked some requests; Rishi, please confirm the final token counts and KV-cache effect before we lock numbers.

—Marcus
Technical Account Lead
[Attachment: credit_calc_v1.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@orbitalinc.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - sustained latency and 5xx spike (need credits)

On Thu, Oct 15, 2026 at 1:28 PM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached preliminary credit_calc_v1.xlsx.

Aaron — quick technical note: the primary cause was a combination of (1) a hardware thermal limit on 3 hosts in pool-prod-us-west causing preemption of worker threads, and (2) a transient regression in the autoscaler that delayed scale-up by ~90s. The team pushed a host-level firmware patch and hot-fixed the autoscaler policy so similar events will trigger faster.

Token accounting: our preliminary audit reduces the impacted token count by ~9% after removing prefix-cached responses; I expect Marcus’ conservative scenario already covers that, but we will deliver final audited numbers by COB Fri (tomorrow).

Technical mitigations applied: host firmware patch, autoscaler config change (lower scale threshold), and a protective routing rule to avoid the affected host pool. We'll add a postmortem with timeline and RCA by next week.

—Rishi
Sr. Reliability Engineer

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@orbitalinc.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - sustained latency and 5xx spike (need credits)

Aaron / Kimberly —

Thanks — Legal has drafted a redline to the Master Services Agreement to document the credit and remediation path. Two options:
1) Standard SLA credit (as calculated) applied to Oct invoice; simple amendment, no change to term.
2) Credit + 30-day Dedicated trial + written operational commitments (RCA within 7 business days, monthly incident review for quarter). This would be a short amendment and a one-time commercial concession.

I attached the redline (contract_amendment_redline.docx). Please let us know which option Orbital prefers; if you need signoff from procurement, we can prepare a condensed summary they can approve.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: contract_amendment_redline.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@orbitalinc.com>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@orbitalinc.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 17:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact - sustained latency and 5xx spike (need credits)

Aaron / Sophie —

Thank you for your patience while we completed the audit. Final proposal:
- Commercial remedy: Scenario B (credit of $12,000 + 30-day Dedicated trial) and a one-time invoice credit that will appear on the Nov billing cycle.
- Operational commitments: RCA delivered by Oct 23; monthly incident review cadence for Q4 with our Solutions team.
- Contract path: Laura will circulate the short amendment redline; we can route for signature via DocuSign.

We would also like an Exec sync (30 minutes) to close the loop on remediation and the Dedicated trial onboarding — can you do Wed 10/21 at 10:00 PT or Thu 10/22 at 11:00 PT?

If you accept the offer, we’ll issue the DocuSign envelope and book the onboarding slot.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 415-555-0147
